title: Digital Transformation and Supply Chain Competitiveness: Evidence of Dynamic Capabilities from an Emerging Economy
core_idea: Examine how digital transformation functions as a strategic enabler of supply chain competitive advantage by enhancing firms' dynamic capabilities, using a quantitative survey of managers in Jordanian manufacturing firms to explore the capability-based mechanisms linking digital investments to competitiveness.
tldr: Investigates whether and how digital transformation improves supply chain competitiveness via firm-level dynamic capabilities in an emerging-economy manufacturing context using a manager survey.
